#diverges broiler-js run Broiler.JS's `JSON.stringify` and `Array.prototype.join` recurse on the platform stack with no guard, so a deeply nested value terminates the process with a stack overflow and every case is lost. The host and Node throw a `RangeError` a program can catch, as they do for a guest-level recursion
